title: Update your watch
description:
Update log:
This update introduces new features and bug fixes. Update now for a smoother experience.
1. Adds the option to wake the screen automatically when you receive notifications. You can turn it on by going to "Settings - Apps & notifications - Notifications" on your watch.
2.Adds the "Workout Time" and "Activity Sessions" complications to Photos watch faces, so you can view your workout data with a quick glance at your wrist.
3. Adds multiple new wellbeing-themed watch faces to help you stay connected with your wellbeing throughout the day.
